paragraphs.text: Princess Lucrezia was a legendary human wizard , who ruled a city-state of the same name in south-western Jamuraa , four centuries after the Ice Age .

The Princess was constantly at war with the shah of Fysmatan , another port city on the shore of the Sea of Serenity . Lucrezian marines, an elite unit of her navy, were one of the most disciplined forces to sail the sea.

During one of the numerous wars between Fysmatan and Lucrezia, the latter was also opposed by the Robaran Mercenaries , led by Adira Strongheart . After having found out that Lucrezian marines had enslaved the Unawanna , a tribe of island natives, to build a flotilla of warships, the Robaran Mercenaries attacked the marines and freed the slaves, selling the new ships to Fysmatan.
Lucrezia's name may be a reference to Lucretia , wife of Tarquinis Collatinus, who committed suicide after being raped and so became a paragon of womanly honor.
